title: Clip
description: Rotations of rig parts over time. Each part turns about its pivot by its x, then y, then z angle, about the axes of its parent, and carries its children with it; a part without keys keeps its rest pose. Angles change linearly between keys and hold the first key before it and the last key after it. Axes: +Y up, +Z forward, +X the character's left; a positive angle turns counterclockwise seen from the positive end of its axis.

duration.description: The clip runs from 0 to duration; a looping player starts again at 0.

parts.description: Keys by rig part name, in time order.

rotation.description: Degrees about x, y and z; a positive x angle swings a hanging limb backward.
